summary.content:
Today's selection covers 104 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 68 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI agents hijacked German website before Hugging Face hack, report claims
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Large Enterprises Targeted in Fake Merger & Acquisition Scams
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 54 articles published in the last 24 hours
